metadata.title: HITE / QTI-MAGANG — Collected Error Logs (manual curation seed)
metadata.purpose: Consolidated record of every error log surfaced during the 2026-08-03/04 working sessions. Operational records are usable as Stage 2 real-data tickets; development records are kept for completeness.
metadata.stage2_mapping: Records with stage2_usable=true map to real_tickets.json via ticket_id + raw_log(as raw_text) + project_tags. Records sharing an incident id describe ONE incident from different vantage points — merge them into a single ticket.

errors.source: laptop PowerShell — curl through SSH tunnel to Mac Mini Ollama
errors.summary: Ollama unreachable: connection reset on localhost:11434
errors.raw_log:
curl.exe http://localhost:11434/api/tags
curl: (56) Recv failure: Connection was reset
errors.context: SSH tunnel (Terminal A) was up and forwarding localhost:11434, but the far side (Mac Mini Ollama) reset the connection. First sign of the Ollama outage.

errors.summary: SSH local-forward channel open failed: far side refused
errors.raw_log: channel 3: open failed: connect failed: Connection refused
errors.context: Every attempt to use the localhost:11434 forward produced this, because the controller could not reach 10.10.10.2:11434. Corroborates ERR-001/ERR-003.

errors.source: controller ferdi@DEBIAN13 — curl -v to Mac Mini Ollama
errors.raw_log:
*   Trying 10.10.10.2:11434...
* connect to 10.10.10.2 port 11434 from 10.10.10.1 port 37982 failed: Connection refused
* Failed to connect to 10.10.10.2 port 11434 after 114 ms: Could not connect to server
* closing connection #0
curl: (7) Failed to connect to 10.10.10.2 port 11434 after 114 ms: Could not connect to server
errors.context: Definitive diagnosis: Mac Mini reachable (ping 0% loss, WireGuard handshake 4s old) but nothing listening on port 11434 -> Ollama service down, not the box or the tunnel.

errors.source: laptop PowerShell — test_run.py during Ollama outage
errors.summary: Evaluation produced 0/55 grounded; every ticket failed in 0.08-0.66s
errors.raw_log:
[1/55] TKT-1001 in 0.17s grounded=False OK
[2/55] TKT-1002 in 0.1s grounded=False OK
... (all 55 tickets 0.08-0.66s, grounded=False) ...
[55/55] TKT-1055 in 0.2s grounded=False OK
errors.context: Symptom of the Ollama outage: each call_ollama failed instantly (connection refused) and the agent fell back to the empty analysis. A genuine run takes 5-20s per ticket. Do NOT commit this evaluation_results.json.

errors.source: Grafana alerting SSE -> Telegram 'HITE QTI Logs' (HITE_Log_ErrorDetected rule)
errors.summary: DatasourceError: Grafana cannot resolve Loki DNS
errors.raw_log: [sse.dataQueryError] failed to execute query [A]: Get "http://loki:3100/loki/api/v1/query?direction=backward&query=sum%28count_over_time%28%7Bnamespace%3D%22monitoring%22%7D+%7C+json+%7C+level%3D%22error%22+%5B5m%5D%29%29&time=1785142120000000000": dial tcp: lookup loki on 10.96.0.10:53: no such host
errors.context: The log-based alert rule's query is sum(count_over_time({namespace="monitoring"} | json | level="error" [5m])). First failure mode: cluster DNS (10.96.0.10) could not resolve the short name 'loki'.

errors.source: Grafana alerting SSE -> Telegram 'HITE QTI Logs' (HITE_Log_ErrorDetected rule)
errors.summary: DatasourceError: Loki ClusterIP reachable but connection times out
errors.raw_log: [sse.dataQueryError] failed to execute query [A]: Get "http://loki:3100/loki/api/v1/query?direction=backward&query=sum%28count_over_time%28%7Bnamespace%3D%22monitoring%22%7D+%7C+json+%7C+level%3D%22error%22+%5B5m%5D%29%29&time=1785583060000000000": dial tcp 10.96.106.44:3100: i/o timeout
errors.context: Second failure mode: DNS now resolves to Loki ClusterIP 10.96.106.44 but the connection times out -> Loki pod unhealthy/down. Embedded Loki query timestamps span roughly 2026-07-26 to 2026-08-01.

errors.summary: Log-based alert flapping Firing<->Resolved every few minutes
errors.raw_log:
Firing  Value: A=1, C=1  alertname=HITE_Log_ErrorDetected  summary=Ditemukan log error di namespace monitoring
Resolved  Value: A=-1, C=-1  grafana_state_reason=NoData
(repeats dozens of times)
errors.context: The Phase 7 log-based alert alternates between Firing (A=1/2/3 errors found) and Resolved (A=-1 NoData), largely because its Loki datasource keeps dropping (see ERR-005/ERR-006). Noisy, not a clean incident feed.

errors.source: laptop PowerShell — ran Linux diagnostics on Windows
errors.summary: ping -c / sudo wg / curl -s failed: wrong OS semantics
errors.raw_log:
ping -c 3 10.10.10.2 -> Access denied. Option -c requires administrative privileges.
sudo wg show wg0 -> Sudo is disabled on this machine.
curl -s --max-time 5 http://10.10.10.2:11434/api/tags -> Invoke-WebRequest : A positional parameter cannot be found that accepts argument 'http://10.10.10.2:11434/api/tags'.
errors.context: Controller-side diagnostic commands were accidentally run on the Windows laptop: Windows ping uses -n, there is no sudo/wg, and PowerShell 'curl' is an alias for Invoke-WebRequest. Not a real incident — terminal mix-up.

errors.summary: TypeError: search_sop() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given
errors.raw_log:
File "...\llm-inference\agent.py", line 113, in process_ticket
    tool_output = tools.search_sop(ticket.raw_text, ticket.project_tags)
TypeError: search_sop() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given
INFO: 127.0.0.1:... "POST /process-ticket HTTP/1.1" 500 Internal Server Error
errors.context: Reconstructed agent.py called tools.search_sop with two arguments, but the real tools.py signature takes one. Fixed by calling tools.search_sop(ticket.raw_text).

errors.summary: Statements must be separated by newlines or semicolons
errors.raw_log:
Statements must be separated by newlines or semicolons — Pylance [Ln 15, Col 112]
OLLAMA_MODEL = os.environ.get("OLLAMA_MODEL", "hf.co/.../Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-Q4_K_M-GGUF:latest")OLLAMA_TIMEOUT = int(os.environ.get(...))
